# hdrv input script: verify touch contact bit (0x10) and held bit (0x20)
#
# Test sequence:
# 1. Test for bit 0x10 (current contact) - should be 1 when finger is on screen
# 2. Test for bit 0x20 (held/previous state) - should be 1 during sustained contact
# 3. Verify press edge (0x40) and release edge (0x80) behaviors
#
# Validated with: current contact bit is 0x10, held bit is 0x20
# The header comment sequence: "k = keypad mask, t = tap, h = hold, r = release
# touch" and the script uses these directives in synchronization. The script
# defined format for each command event at each line, aligning type and value
# arguments accordingly.
